review_candidates.title: Senior Aws devops team lead
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The person in this role will lead a DevOps team in designing, implementing, and maintaining AWS-based infrastructures that support OTT, VAS, and cloud hosting solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, infrastructure-as-code deployments, monitoring and logging solutions, and system reliability improvements. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 5–8+ years of experience
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 5–8+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure. Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and architecture . Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) , particularly Terraform . Leadership Qualifications Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop DevOps engineers .
